subject: Eval on-ramp: playbook, success metrics and requested load signature
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@quantix.ai>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@platformretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Eval on-ramp: playbook, success metrics and requested load signature

Hi Samir / Alyssa —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth before we move into a short POC: 

Summary (from today)
- Goal: validate Redwood inference for Quantix AI’s recommendation inference at 99th percentile latency < 120ms for 512-token requests while meeting cost targets.
- Primary workload: user-facing recommendations and rerank; median prompt ~120 tokens, tail up to ~1,200 tokens for context-rich sessions.

What we need from you to scope the trial
1) A small sample of production request metadata (RPS distribution, token-length histogram, concurrency and burst patterns). A CSV example is fine.
2) Success criteria: explicit pass/fail thresholds for latency (p50/p95/p99), error budget, and quality delta tolerance vs baseline model.
3) Target timeline: two-week onramp (ingest/profile), two-week stability/optimized run, evaluation window.

My ask: can you share (1) by EOD Thursday 12/3 so Karthik can map to capacity and propose an ingest plan? If not, let us know what date works.

Attached below is a small template CSV with column hints — fill in whatever you can.

Thanks — I’ll own coordination on our side. Karthik will build the trial config and Lauren will handle billing/contract next steps.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sample-traffic-template.csv (CSV, 4 KB)]
From: Samir Patel <samir@quantix.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@platformretail.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 10:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Eval on-ramp: playbook, success metrics and requested load signature

Diego —

Thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers and a small sample attached. I exported a rolling 48h window and redacted user ids. Key notes:
- Steady-state: 18 RPS average (95th ~45 RPS).
- Concurrency: typical 10 concurrent inference threads; bursts up to 220 concurrent for 90–120s during batch refresh windows (nightly).
- Token lengths: median prompt 118 tokens, 95th 640 tokens, max observed 1,350 tokens (rare).
- Traffic shape: 70% short requests (<=200 tokens), 25% mid (200–700), 5% long (>700).
- Baseline latency (current infra): p50 42ms, p95 210ms, p99 420ms for our current hosted model (we use distill-3b).

Attached: sample-traffic.csv (notes included on column meanings). We can tweak the export window if you want longer history.

A couple of asks from our side:
- Can Redwood provide an initial estimate for the GPU sizing and expected cost-per-1k-tokens for the two-week optimized run?
- We’ll need a list of redwood-managed telemetry hooks we should enable (request ids, model name, latency, tokens).

Thanks — I looped Alyssa for any procurement timing constraints.

Samir Patel
Head of ML Engineering | Quantix AI
[Attachment: sample-traffic.csv (CSV, 12 KB)]
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@quantix.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 08:57:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Eval on-ramp: playbook, success metrics and requested load signature

Samir — great data, thanks for the quick turnaround. I reviewed the CSV and sketched a POC onramp we can run next week. High level plan below (we’ll flesh into milestones if Quantix wants to proceed):

POC Onramp (timeline & owners)
- Day 0–2: Ingest sample trace into staging, validate tokenization/seq-len buckets (owner: Karthik).
- Day 3–6: Baseline run on 1x V100-equivalent (smoke), confirm p50/p95 latency mapping for 3 payload classes.
- Day 7–10: Optimized run with batching and prefix caching enabled; iterate quantization profile if needed (owner: Diego).
- Day 11–14: Evaluation window: 48h steady-state + 1x burst test (simulate 220 concurrent for 120s). Run automated quality regression checks vs your baseline.

Success criteria (proposed — please confirm / adjust)
- Performance: p99 under 150ms for <=700 token requests during steady-state; p95 under 300ms for long-tail (<=1,350 tokens) during burst test.
- Reliability: error rate < 0.1% over the 48h eval window.
- Quality: allowed generation delta no greater than 2% measured on your eval prompt set (we’ll need your truth sets).

Immediate asks from Quantix (to finalize sizing/cost):
- Confirm whether max observed 1,350 token requests can be truncated for the POC or must be preserved.
- Share your eval prompt-set or a subset for quality gating.

Attachments: I’m adding a draft milestone tracker we’ll use for handoffs.

If that timeline looks good I’ll reserve capacity and send a calendar block. Lauren — can you prepare the trial SOW and send a short pricing statement for the two-week flow?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: poc-milestones.xlsx (XLSX, 28 KB)]
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@quantix.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 15:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Eval on-ramp: playbook, success metrics and requested load signature

Samir — perfect, thank you. Quick confirmation and next steps: 

1) We’ll assume preserving the 1,350 token max for correctness unless you explicitly ask us to truncate for the POC. Please confirm by EOD Monday 12/7 if you want truncation.
2) Karthik will spin the staging ingest on Monday 12/7; please make S3 export or CSV available to the shared drive before then.
3) Lauren will circulate a short SOW + trial pricing link and a DocuSign for the one-time trial waiver.

Links / calendar
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/QNTX-2026-0047
- Playbook (internal): https://drive.redwood.ai/playbooks/eval-onramp-v2
- Proposed kickoff: Mon 2026-12-07 10:00 AM PST — I’ll send the invite once Samir confirms.

If anything changes on your procurement side, loop Lauren. Otherwise we’ll proceed as above.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — Developer-first LLM inference
